scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c auto "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix client run test:coverage
scripts.test:critical: npm --prefix server run test:critical && npm --prefix client run test:critical
scripts.qa: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run qa:static && npm run deployment:validate
scripts.db:migrate: npm run achievements:migrate-indexes && npm run rivalries:migrate-indexes && npm run challenges:migrate-indexes && npm run hall-of-fame:migrate-indexes && npm run seasons:migrate-indexes && npm run notifications:migrate-indexes && npm run ai:migrate-indexes
scripts.db:prepare: npm run db:migrate && npm run seed:defaults
